title: SSH run command
description: Execute one allow-listed read-only shell command on an inventory SSH target. Approved families: hostname/hostnamectl/uname; cat /etc/os-release|/proc/{meminfo,cpuinfo,version}; id/whoami/who -b/uptime; df/free/lscpu/lsblk/blkid; ps; ss/netstat listen views; systemctl status|is-active|is-enabled|list-units; dpkg/rpm query; psql/postgres --version; command -v|which <bin>; smartctl -H|-i /dev/<disk>; sysctl/getent; ls/stat under postgresql paths. No pipes, redirects, shell composition, or interpreters.

command.description: Exact allow-listed remote command (no shell metacharacters).
